text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Visiting Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~... Both Sweep Tosho and
Zenno Rob Roy are totally fired up~...!

text_block_list.name: Visiting Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Both of you are running in the upcoming Tenno Sho (Autumn), right?!
Hey, who do you think is gonna win?

text_block_list.name: Visiting Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Well, right after the Takarazuka Kinen, it's gotta be Sweep Tosho!
It only makes sense for the strongest Umamusume to win!

text_block_list.name: Visiting Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?! Rob Roy won't lose!
She's not the kind of girl to be discouraged
by losing just once or twice!

text_block_list.name: Visiting Fan D
text_block_list.text:
If it's our hero, she'll defeat the witch
and claim the top once more!

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
................
...Asking for another chance, of all things...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Just one more set...!

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Rob Roy-san, do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Yes?
Is there something you need...?

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Why are you taking on the "challenge" again?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ? A challenge, you say...

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I looked into you.
And once I did, I just couldn't help asking.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Because up until the Classic Year,
you seemed like a completely different person compared to now.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It might sound a bit blunt,
but up until that point, you were rather shy
and seemed like a timid Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Even while participating in the interview,
she looked somewhat frightened."

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...Especially during the press conferences after the Derby.
She had this look like, 'Even if everyone expects things from me,
I just can't live up to it.'"

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
She had a look on her face that made it seem like
she really didn't want anyone to talk to her...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
............ A-Ahaha... um...
Was it really written all over my face back then...?

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —Yet, all of a sudden, you were no longer afraid.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
She had a stellar run in the Senior Year and was even crowned Umamusume of the Year.
...And then, out of nowhere, she started talking about her goals.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Even now, she's trying to take on a new challenge.
With the determined look of a challenger.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Why?

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Where do you find that kind of courage?
...Don't you ever feel afraid?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...It's scary, you know.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Even now, my voice trembles whenever I talk about my goal.
Even so, but still...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Because Sweep-san cast a spell on me.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ! Sweep-san...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Just as you say, during my Classic Year, I did nothing but betray expectations.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: It feels presumptuous to even speak of the dream of being a hero. I'm just so pathetic and ashamed of myself.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
“One day, though—I was completely blinded
by a light more selfish, reckless, and dazzling than anything else.”

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Looking at that star... I found myself wishing for it, too.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Once the fire was ignited, it couldn't be stopped.
Her heart had already begun to burn."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "You'll definitely understand once you see it in person. Her magic is terrifyingly wonderful."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The closer I get to that light,
the more I crave it.
It's so unfair, so frustrating—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "—I believe that through her magic, the feeling of 'giving up' inside me was completely burned away."

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
…………
...Even someone like me...

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Even I felt frustrated when watching her run.
Both during the Oka Sho, and during the Yushun Himba.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "Still, no matter how frustrating it is, there are just some things you can't beat...!"

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —Because I saw it... On TV, watching her Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I felt like I couldn't even stand in the same place as her anymore,
like there was an invisible wall between us—and yet...

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...And yet.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Why do I still feel so frustrated?
Why...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"I don't care about that!
Things like 'normal' or 'common sense'—
I just have to blast through them with magic!"

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Do you... want me to destroy it?
